input.quote: 7.2 The O&M Costs as defined in Paragraph 6 shall be borne by the Parties in the proportions set forth in Schedule B.
input.rationale: Paragraphs 7.1 and 7.2 commit us to bear Capital Costs and O&M Costs in the fixed Schedule B proportions, and Paragraph 18.1 locks that obligation in for a 25-year Initial Period with no right to terminate participation (only unanimous agreement under 18.2) and no unilateral right to reduce our Investment Share. Exit or non-payment is penalised rather than trued up: no credit for capital costs on termination, and under 23.2 reclaimed capacity carries no payment, credit or reimbursement. Paragraphs 13.2 and 14.1 (no Party forced to fund upgrades) help but do not touch the baseline share. That is a multi-year take-or-pay with no reduction or termination right, i.e. walk-away territory. Preferred (pay only for usage) would require rewriting the consortium's ownership economics, so we take the fallback: one inserted subparagraph 7.2A limiting our commitment to the then-current 12-month period, allowing reduction on 30 days' notice, and settling any shortfall by true-up rather than penalty or forfeiture. Drafted as a Teleglobe-only right so other Parties cannot shed share onto us.

proposal.summary: Add a 12-month cap, 30-day reduction right and true-up for our cost-share commitment under Paragraph 7
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Paragraphs 7.1-7.2 bind us to a fixed proportional share of Capital Costs and O&M Costs for the full 25-year Initial Period, with no reduction right and forfeiture-style consequences, which is take-or-pay without an exit. We have added our playbook fallback: the commitment runs only for the current 12-month period, we may reduce it on 30 days' notice, and any shortfall is settled by true-up rather than penalty.

ops.text: Teleglobe USA Inc.'s commitment to bear Capital Costs and O&M Costs under Subparagraphs 7.1 and 7.2 is limited to the then-current twelve (12) month period, and Teleglobe USA Inc. may reduce that commitment, and its Investment Share in Schedule B, on thirty (30) days' written notice to the Management Committee. Any shortfall resulting from such reduction shall be settled by a true-up of costs actually incurred and allocated, and not by any penalty, forfeiture or reclamation of capacity.
